answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The echo holds work receipts rather than names, so the juniper of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
